name: Giant Bumblebee
publication: The Land Beyond the Magic Mirror
author: Gary Gygax
sourceHeading: B. Garden of Colossal Flowers and New Monsters, Bee, Giant, Bumble-bee column
appearanceEvidence: Species prose and original printed artwork, with details matching the staged portrait noted where inferred.
habitatEvidence: Specific habitats, ecological ranges and encounter locations come from the original printed folios.
sourceNotes: Printed p. 27 has “String” in the bumblebee special attack row. The surrounding bee prose and the garden poison block establish that the attack is a sting. No garden sting-use limit is printed and the general column does not say “Sting once” as workers and soldiers do.
The printed garden block has movement 3″/24″ and HP 36; the general bee table has 6″/24″ and no fixed HP.
The generic bumblebee level/XP field is incomplete. Do not infer a coefficient from the honey bees.

artworkSource: Original OpenAI ImageGen portrait in this part
sourceNotes: The appendix line reads “x2 on initiative.” The explanatory paragraph and encounter block each specify +2 on initiative. Use the explained +2 modifier with the stated one attack.
The general appendix places “save as 16th level magic-user” in its magic-resistance column. The actual 25% resistance appears in the road encounter and is scoped there.
The appendix gives no numeric morale. Use the printed casualty and damage thresholds for the road encounter.
